message.content:
**Eiffel Tower Height**

| Measurement | Value |
|-------------|-------|
| **Official structural height** (without antennas) | **324 metres** – which equals approximately **1 064 feet** (≈ 324 × 3.281 = 1 062–1 065 ft depending on rounding). |
| **Total height including antennas** | About **330 metres**, or roughly **1 084 feet**. |

So if you’re looking at the classic “tower” itself it’s just over **1 060 feet tall**. If you include its modern broadcasting antennas, it reaches close to **1 085 feet**.
